AUTHOR: Rimmer
TITLE: Underwater Computer Vision for Ecologists: A Framework for Curating Image Training Datasets for Object Detection
REGION: Two seaweed (kelp) farms and reference sites, Barkley and Clayoquot Sounds, British Columbia, Canada
SPECIES: 23 pseudo-taxa of fishes (surfperches, shiner perch, pile perch, forage fish, Pacific herring, rockfish, salmonids, tubesnout) and gelatinous zooplankton, plus drift algae
DATA: Own unbaited RUV 'FishCam' footage, 12 cameras, Mar 2022-Jun 2023 (9037 h); training/test frames from Mar-Nov 2022; ~241,000 annotations
V_EV: Sec 2.2.2: videos 'were often obscured by high turbidity, fast movement, light attenuation or insufficient camera resolution'; Sec 2.1: 'cameras were deployed at 6 m depth'
D_EV: Sec 2.2.9: 'we reserved 10% of all images, with representatives from all categories, to test our output model.'
R_EV: Sec 3.1.2: test dataset of 8376 images drawn from the same Mar-Nov 2022 FishCam annotated dataset; no external evaluation with results.
C_EV: Sec 3.1.2: 'Model evaluation metrics... were calculated using an optimal confidence threshold of 0.25... The threshold was selected based on the F1 score'
E_EV: Sec 3.1: only precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95, F1 and confusion matrix reported; MaxN computed for parent project but 'detailed in Bates et al. [19]'.
ARCH: YOLOv8 (final); screening with salient motion filter, ResNet-18 binary classifier, YOLOv5; Online-InReaCh anomaly filter (Wide-ResNet-50)
METR: Precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50-95, F1, confusion matrix; annotation-effort retraining curves
NOTE: Seaweed farm + reference sites in open coastal water, wild fauna -> treated as semi-natural field deployment, not aquaculture cage. Multi-taxon (fish + jellyfish) with fish results reported per class. Image count ambiguous (text says ~241,000 annotated images but test set of 8376 images = 10%) -> NIMG null. MaxN abundance computed but reported elsewhere (E1=없음). PRE=ImageNet per Discussion statement 'transfer learning from the ImageNet task'. Model later applied to Dec 2022-Jun 2023 footage but no performance reported -> R1=N.
